SELECT COALESCE(s.sku_code,'历史未关联') skuCode,COALESCE(s.product_name,m.model_name) productName,w.warehouse_name warehouseName,l.location_name locationName, COUNT(*) physicalQty,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_production_issue i WHERE i.status='OPEN' AND (i.code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci=v.frame_sn COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_vehicle_part_binding b WHERE b.vehicle_id=v.id AND b.is_current=1 AND b.part_sn COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci=i.code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci)))) quarantinedQty FROM bike_vehicle v LEFT JOIN bike_production_vehicle p ON p.vehicle_id=v.id LEFT JOIN bike_production_sku s ON s.id=p.sku_id LEFT JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=v.model_id LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse w ON w.id=v.current_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse_location l ON l.id=v.current_location_id WHERE v.status=2 AND p.sku_id=#{skuId}AND v.current_warehouse_id=#{warehouseId} GROUP BY s.id,s.sku_code,s.product_name,m.id,m.model_name,w.id,w.warehouse_name,l.id,l.location_name ORDER BY s.id,w.id,l.id
